name: @openmotion/desktop
description: OpenMotion cross-platform Electron desktop shell for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
author: OpenMotion Contributors

scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --dir
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack:mac:local: npm run build && npm run stage && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --linux
